tours.title: Rick's Cafe Cliff Diving & Sunset
tours.description: The legendary Negril cliffs: jump if you dare, or hold a drink and watch the divers while the sun drops into the sea.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel
Your MAPL host for the evening

tours.title: Dunn's River Falls Climb
tours.description: Climb the 600-foot cascading falls hand-in-hand up the terraces, then cool off in the pools at the top. Jamaica's most famous natural attraction, done with a guide who knows the safe line.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel

tours.title: Bob Marley Nine Mile Pilgrimage
tours.description: Up into the hills of St. Ann to the house where Robert Nesta Marley was born and the mausoleum where he rests, told by guides from the village.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel

tours.title: Bamboo Rafting on the Martha Brae
tours.description: Float three miles down the Martha Brae on a handcrafted 30-foot bamboo raft, poled by a licensed captain who has run this river for years.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel

tours.title: Blue Hole & Secret Falls
tours.description: Swim, cliff-jump and rope-swing into turquoise limestone pools hidden in the rainforest. Quieter than Dunn's River and twice as wild.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel

tours.title: Parasailing Over the Bay
tours.description: Lifted above the turquoise from the deck of the boat, with the whole coastline laid out beneath you.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel
Flight with parachute, harness and life vest

tours.title: River Tubing
tours.description: Drop into the current on a tube and let the river do the work. Easy, cold, and the best kind of lazy.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel

tours.title: Dunn's River + Blue Hole
tours.description: Both of Jamaica's headline waterfalls in one day: climb Dunn's River in the morning, jump the Blue Hole in the afternoon.
included: Round-trip private transport from your hotel and between both sites
Dunn's River and Blue Hole entry
A licensed guide at each falls
Life vest at the Blue Hole
